entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s over a subquery wrapping a native-histogram-valued shape is unsupported
entries.rationale: the canonical range-function gate admits exactly the names recognized by chplan.IsPromQLRangeWindowFunc. For histogram-bearing wideInner rows, lowerHistogramOrMixedCallSubqueryInput handles all SELECT/FOLD names and histogramSubqueryFloatOnlyDropFunc handles the remainder by returning an empty float result. The partition is exhaustive, so this trailing rejection is not wire-reachable.

guard: past returning if err := requirePositiveInnerRange(innerSub); err != nil
past returning if err := requireMixedPlanPolicy(wideInner, mixedSubqueryFamily); err != nil
past returning if node, matched, err := lowerHistogramOrMixedCallSubqueryInput(wideInner, kind, call.Func.Name, sub, innerSub, step, s, ctx); matched

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s does not accept a subquery argument
entries.rationale: lowerSubqueryOverCall is the only caller and dispatches here only after its own range-window vocabulary gate has admitted the call, so chplan.IsPromQLRangeWindowFunc has already answered true for the same canonicalised name by the time this check runs
